subject: English
passage: Roberto Clemente of Puerto Rico ______ a passionate advocate for disaster relief efforts in the early 1970s. The commitment of Clemente and his fellow humanitarian workers was tragically highlighted in 1972, when he died in a plane crash while delivering aid to earthquake victims in Nicaragua.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "was" agrees in number with the singular subject "Roberto Clemente of Puerto Rico."
